planets.name: WASP-189 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-189 with a 2.72-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: WASP-189 b was found in 2020 by CHEOPS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-189. Its orbit and size follow Lendl et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LENDL_ET_AL__2020): disc_year 2020, disc_facility CHaracterising ExOPlanets Satellite (CHEOPS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.7240308, pl_radj 1.619, pl_bmassj 1.99

quotes.title: WASP-189 b
quotes.card: WASP-189 b is an ultra-hot jupiter that orbits around the A-type star WASP-189 which is located about 322 light years from Earth in the Libra constellation.
quotes.introduction: It was first discovered in 2018, and was observed in 2020 by CHEOPS.
